$comment: Perform mode = the full-screen chart view the band reads from iPads during a service. 'Chart' = the sheet music file. Musical key names (G#m), chord symbols and 'BPM' stay as written in every language.

capo.where: Perform mode: capo badge in the status pill (top corner) and on the transpose button
capo.context: {fret} is the capo fret number (1-11). Capo = guitar capo; keep the musician's usual word.

songPosition.where: Perform mode toolbar: small line under the song title (shown in capitals via CSS)
songPosition.context: {position} is this song's number in the queue, {total} the number of songs with charts

songPositionWithName.where: Perform mode: screen-reader label of the status pill in the top corner
songPositionWithName.context: {position}/{total} as in songPosition; {songName} is the song title (data)

toolbar.printChartFailed.where: Perform mode desktop toolbar: red alert above the print button when printing the open chart fails

toolbar.transposeUnavailableImage.where: Perform mode toolbar: tooltip and label of the greyed-out Transpose button when the chart is a photo/image
toolbar.transposeUnavailableImage.context: PDF and MusicXML are file formats; keep them as written

toolbar.zoomOut.where: Perform mode toolbar: zoom-out icon button (screen-reader label)

toolbar.zoomIn.where: Perform mode toolbar: zoom-in icon button (screen-reader label)

toolbar.resetZoomAria.where: Perform mode toolbar: the zoom percentage button that resets zoom (screen-reader label)

toolbar.resetZoomTitle.where: Perform mode toolbar: tooltip of the zoom percentage button

toolbar.fitPageAria.where: Perform mode toolbar: fit-mode icon button when it will switch to whole-page fit (PDF charts only)

toolbar.fitWidthAria.where: Perform mode toolbar: fit-mode icon button when it will switch to full-width fit (PDF charts only)

toolbar.fitPageTitle.where: Perform mode toolbar: tooltip of the fit-mode button (whole page)

toolbar.fitWidthTitle.where: Perform mode toolbar: tooltip of the fit-mode button (full width)

toolbar.monitorAria.where: Perform mode toolbar: button that opens the personal monitor (wedge) mix panel, screen-reader label

toolbar.monitor.where: Perform mode toolbar (touch layout): label of the monitor-mix button

toolbar.monitorCaps.where: Perform mode toolbar (desktop layout): label of the monitor-mix button, written in capitals
toolbar.monitorCaps.context: Same word as 'monitor', in capitals where the script has them

toolbar.noMonitor.where: Perform mode: monitor-mix popover when no mixer is reachable

toolbar.transpose.where: Perform mode toolbar (touch layout): label of the disabled transpose button on image charts

toolbar.transposeCaps.where: Perform mode toolbar (desktop layout): label of the disabled transpose button on image charts, in capitals
toolbar.transposeCaps.context: Same word as 'transpose', in capitals where the script has them

toolbar.scan.where: Perform mode toolbar (touch layout): transpose button label while chords are being scanned from the chart

toolbar.scanCaps.where: Perform mode toolbar (desktop layout): transpose button label while scanning, in capitals
toolbar.scanCaps.context: Same word as 'scan', in capitals where the script has them

toolbar.capoCaps.where: Perform mode toolbar (desktop layout): transpose button label when a capo is set, in capitals
toolbar.capoCaps.context: {fret} is the capo fret number. Same as 'capo', in capitals where the script has them

toolbar.exit.where: Perform mode toolbar: Exit button that leaves the chart view

toolbar.exitTitle.where: Perform mode desktop toolbar: tooltip of the Exit button

toolbar.printingChart.where: Perform mode desktop toolbar: print button label while printing is in progress

toolbar.printChart.where: Perform mode desktop toolbar: print icon button (prints only the open chart)

nav.previousSong.where: Perform mode toolbar: previous-song arrow button (screen-reader label)

nav.nextSong.where: Perform mode toolbar: next-song arrow button (screen-reader label)

nav.noSongSelected.where: Perform mode toolbar: shown in place of the song title when nothing is open

nav.setlistEmpty.where: Perform mode toolbar: line under the title when the setlist has no charts

metronome.startTitle.where: Perform mode toolbar: tooltip of the metronome light button (when stopped)

metronome.stopTitle.where: Perform mode toolbar: tooltip of the metronome light button (when running)

metronome.startAria.where: Perform mode toolbar: screen-reader label of the metronome button (when stopped)

metronome.stopAria.where: Perform mode toolbar: screen-reader label of the metronome button (when running)

metronome.tempoFlashAria.where: Perform mode: screen-reader label of the large tempo overlay shown when a song opens
metronome.tempoFlashAria.context: {bpm} is the tempo number; keep 'BPM' as written

offline.offlineChartsReady.where: Perform mode: offline pill at the top of the screen
offline.offlineChartsReady.context: {ready} charts of {total} are saved on this device. English is in capitals; use capitals only if the script has them.

offline.setlistUpdated.where: Perform setlist page: slim strip under the header, shown on signed-out devices when the setlist changed after the page loaded

offline.offlineMode.where: Perform mode: offline pill at the top of the screen

offline.reconnected.where: Perform mode: pill shown for 3 seconds when the network comes back

keepAwake.osWarningTitle.where: Perform mode: bottom warning strip on old iPads running the Home-Screen app (bold first sentence)

keepAwake.osWarningBody.where: Perform mode: bottom warning strip, explanation after the bold sentence
keepAwake.osWarningBody.context: Settings → Display & Brightness → Auto-Lock → Never is the iPad settings path; use the iPad's own menu names in the target language

keepAwake.tapToDismiss.where: Perform mode: faint hint at the end of the warning strip

keepAwake.screenMaySleep.where: Perform mode: bottom strip when the keep-screen-on lock was lost; tapping re-arms it

keepAwake.errorHidden.where: Perform mode: red alert above the keep-screen-on button when the request failed because the tab was in the background

keepAwake.errorDenied.where: Perform mode: red alert above the keep-screen-on button when the browser refused the request

keepAwake.lockOnAria.where: Perform mode header/toolbar: screen-reader label of the keep-screen-on button while the lock is held

keepAwake.keepScreenOn.where: Perform mode header/toolbar: screen-reader label of the keep-screen-on button

keepAwake.unavailableAria.where: Perform mode: screen-reader label of the disabled keep-screen-on button on devices without the feature

keepAwake.unavailableTitle.where: Perform mode: tooltip of the disabled keep-screen-on button

keepAwake.screenOn.where: Perform mode: short label on the keep-screen-on button while active

keepAwake.keepOn.where: Perform mode: short label on the keep-screen-on button while inactive

liveDirector.back.where: Live-edit sheet (long-press on a chart): back arrow button label

liveDirector.changeKey.where: Live-edit sheet: heading and action tile title

liveDirector.swapChart.where: Live-edit sheet: heading and action tile title

liveDirector.insertSong.where: Live-edit sheet: heading while inserting a song

liveDirector.liveEdit.where: Live-edit sheet: heading when the row has no title

liveDirector.actionsAria.where: Live-edit sheet: screen-reader name of the action list

liveDirector.changeKeyDescription.where: Live-edit sheet: grey line under 'Change key'

liveDirector.swapChartDescription.where: Live-edit sheet: grey line under 'Swap chart'
liveDirector.swapChartDescription.context: bond = link the setlist row to a chart file

liveDirector.insertNewSongDescription.where: Live-edit sheet: grey line under 'Insert new song'

liveDirector.changeKeyFailed.where: Live-edit sheet, change key: red error when saving fails

liveDirector.currentKey.where: Live-edit sheet, change key: label before the row's current musical key

liveDirector.saving.where: Live-edit sheet, change key: screen-reader label of the spinner

liveDirector.tapKeyToCommit.where: Live-edit sheet, change key: hint under the key picker

liveDirector.swapFailed.where: Live-edit sheet, swap chart: red error when saving fails

liveDirector.searchLibrary.where: Live-edit sheet, swap chart: search box placeholder and label

liveDirector.libraryLoading.where: Live-edit sheet: empty results while the chart library is still loading

liveDirector.noMatchingCharts.where: Live-edit sheet: empty results for a search

liveDirector.swapToSong.where: Live-edit sheet, swap chart: screen-reader label of each result

liveDirector.insertFailed.where: Live-edit sheet, insert song: red error when saving fails

liveDirector.searchSongToInsert.where: Live-edit sheet, insert song: search box placeholder and label

liveDirector.typeToSearch.where: Live-edit sheet, insert song: empty results before typing

liveDirector.insertSongNamed.where: Live-edit sheet, insert song: screen-reader label of each result

liveDirector.placementBefore.where: Live-edit sheet, insert song: segmented choice — insert before the pressed row

liveDirector.placementAfter.where: Live-edit sheet, insert song: segmented choice — insert after the pressed row

liveDirector.placementEnd.where: Live-edit sheet, insert song: segmented choice — append at the end of the setlist

liveDirector.whereToInsert.where: Live-edit sheet, insert song: screen-reader name of the before/after/end choice

liveDirector.clearSearch.where: Live-edit sheet: × button inside the search box

tonight.title.context: Changes the chart for tonight's service only

tonight.staleChanged.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: red message when another leader changed the row first
tonight.staleChanged.context: {chartTitle} is the title of the chart now showing, or the 'anotherChart' text

tonight.anotherChart.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: stands in for {chartTitle} in staleChanged when the title is unknown

tonight.swapFailed.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: red message when the swap could not be saved

tonight.planned.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: section heading for the planned chart (shown in capitals via CSS)

tonight.backToPlan.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: grey detail under the planned chart while a swap is active

tonight.thePlan.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: grey detail under the planned chart

tonight.noChartInPlan.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: planned section when the row has no chart

tonight.sameMoment.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: section heading — charts for the same moment of the service

tonight.sameTitle.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: section heading — other arrangements with the same title

tonight.search.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: section heading above the search box

tonight.searchAria.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: search box screen-reader label

tonight.clearSearch.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: × button inside the search box

tonight.libraryLoading.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: empty search results while the library loads

tonight.alsoSave.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: checkbox label at the bottom

tonight.alsoSaveHint.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: grey hint under the checkbox

tonight.showingNowAria.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: screen-reader label of the chart that is currently showing

tonight.swapToAria.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: screen-reader label of each candidate chart

tonight.showingNow.where: Swap-for-tonight sheet: grey detail under the chart that is currently showing

overlay.chart.where: Perform chart view: name used in the error box when the chart viewer crashes ('<name> failed to load')

overlay.unknownTitle.where: Perform chart view: heading when the file type can't be shown

overlay.unknownBody.where: Perform chart view: explanation under 'Can't render this file type yet'
overlay.unknownBody.context: {songName} is the setlist row's title (data, shown in a monospace font)

overlay.liveSetlist.where: Print dialog opened from Perform mode: default title of the printout

overlay.dialogLabel.where: Perform chart view: screen-reader name of the full-screen chart dialog

overlay.scrollRegion.where: Perform chart view: screen-reader name of the scrollable chart area, with how to scroll it from a keyboard
overlay.scrollRegion.context: Page Up and Page Down are key names; keep them as printed on the keyboard

saveOffline.saving.where: Perform setlist header: save-offline button label while saving

saveOffline.saved.where: Perform setlist header: save-offline button label when every chart is saved on this device
saveOffline.saved.context: {total} is the number of charts (appears twice: N/N)

saveOffline.partial.where: Perform setlist header: save-offline button label when some charts are saved

saveOffline.idle.where: Perform setlist header: save-offline button label

saveOffline.save.where: Perform setlist header: the blue button that saves the charts not yet on this device
saveOffline.save.context: {count} is how many charts are still missing from this device

saveOffline.savingAria.where: Perform setlist header: screen-reader label of the save-offline button while saving

saveOffline.allSavedAria.where: Perform setlist header: screen-reader label when every chart is saved

saveOffline.partialAria.where: Perform setlist header: screen-reader label when some charts are saved

saveOffline.idleAria.where: Perform setlist header: screen-reader label of the save-offline button

saveLabelPlaybackSpeed.where: Rehearsal audio player: error toast when saving the chosen playback speed fails; fills {action} in appSync.saveFailed ("Couldn't save {action} — try again")
saveLabelPlaybackSpeed.context: A lowercase noun phrase dropped into another sentence. The English says 'metronome speed' but it is the rehearsal recording's playback speed; translate as playback speed.

toolbar.tapEdges.where: Perform mode toolbar: on/off button (label and tooltip). When on, a tap on the right or left third of the chart scrolls a screen forward or back, then moves to the next or previous song.

nav.nextUp.where: Perform mode toolbar, under the current song name: the next song's title and its musical key in brackets
nav.nextUp.context: {title} is a song title, {key} a musical key like Dm; keep the key as written.

nav.nextUpNoKey.where: Perform mode toolbar, under the current song name: the next song's title when it has no key

noteStrip.vocalLead.where: Perform mode, slim line at the top of an open chart: who sings lead on this song
noteStrip.vocalLead.context: Same term as the setlist editor's Vocal Lead column. {name} is a person's name.

noteStrip.expand.where: Perform mode, slim note line at the top of an open chart: screen-reader label when the note is cut to one line and a tap shows all of it

noteStrip.collapse.where: Perform mode, slim note line at the top of an open chart: screen-reader label when the whole note shows and a tap folds it back to one line
